title: DiscordAuthPlus
description: A plugin that allows you to log in via Discord
body:
# DiscordAuthPlus — Next Generation Authentication

**_Modern Discord to Minecraft linking system_** ~~for your SMP~~

### 🚀 **Core Features:**

<details>
<summary>🔐 Security & Protection</summary>

> 1. **Login confirmation required** — for new IP addresses or after server restart
> 2. **Automatic IP ban** — 10 minutes upon connection rejection
> 3. **Instant account unlinking** — if compromise is suspected
> 4. **Real-time Discord notifications** — about all login attempts
</details>

<details>
<summary>⚙️ Flexible Configuration</summary>

> 1. **Full message customization** — via config.yml
> 2. **Color codes support** — &a, &c, &e, etc.
> 3. **Timing adjustments** — customize linking time limits
> 4. **Localization** — for any community language
</details>

<details>
<summary>🤖 Discord Integration</summary>

> 1. **Simple linking** — through Discord commands
> 2. **Interactive buttons** — "Approve" / "It's not me"
> 3. **DM-based workflow** — all confirmations via private messages
> 4. **Secure storage** — tokens and data protected
</details>

---

## 📋 **Plugin Commands:**

| Command | Description | Permissions |
|---------|-------------|-------------|
| `/DiscordAuthPlus reload` | Reloads plugin config* | `DiscordAuthPlus.reload` |
| `/DiscordAuthPlus Unconnect` | Unlink your own Discord account | All players |
| `/DiscordAuthPlus UnconnectUser <nick>` | Unlink another player | `DiscordAuthPlus.UnconnectUser` |
| `/DiscordAuthPlus UserInfo <nick>` | Getting information about a player | `DiscordAuthPlus.UserInfo` |


> **\*Important:** Discord bot restart requires server restart

---

## 🔐 **Permission System:**

```yaml
DiscordAuthPlus.reload:
  description: "Allows reloading plugin configuration"
  default: op

DiscordAuthPlus.UnconnectUser:
  description: "Allows unlinking other players' Discord accounts"
  default: op
  
DiscordAuthPlus.UserInfo:
  description: UserInfo Permission
  default: op
